title: Valid program
description: Functions, a while loop and arithmetic. Parses cleanly; shows the token stream and AST.
why: Baseline: what a correct program looks like through every stage.

title: Missing semicolon
description: A declaration without its ';'. Bison only notices at the next line.
why: The detection point (next line) differs from the cause; layout evidence locates the line end.

title: Missing ')'
description: An if-condition without its closing parenthesis.
why: One clearly best repair; alternatives exist but need follow-on edits.

title: Missing '{'
description: A while loop whose body lost its opening brace; the error surfaces lines later.
why: Structurally different repairs parse; indentation evidence ranks the intended one first, but the margin is small so IntelliFix reports alternatives.

title: Missing operand
description: A binary operator without its right operand.
why: Deleting the operator or inventing an operand are both possible; IntelliFix does not pretend to know which.

title: Two errors
description: A missing ';' and a missing ')' in the same function.
why: Hypothesis lanes repair the errors one after another and test which later diagnostics are stable.

title: Ambiguous operator
description: Two operands with no operator between them.
why: Many structurally different repairs are equally supported: a textbook case for abstention.

title: Missing variable name
why: Every repair must invent an identifier, so IntelliFix reports low confidence instead of guessing.

title: Valid nested program
description: Arrays, for-loops, nested if/else and logical operators.
why: Shows a deeper AST and the lack of false alarms on valid code.

title: Invalid character
why: Lexical error tokens flow into the parser; deleting vs. replacing the character changes the AST.

title: Unsupported C construct
description: Uses i++, which MiniC deliberately omits.
why: IntelliFix distinguishes 'not MiniC' from a typo and refuses to silently rewrite it.

title: Extra ')'
description: A duplicated closing parenthesis after a call.
why: Deleting the extra ')' and inserting a matching '(' produce the same AST and are grouped; the runner-up (turning ')' into ';', i.e. an extra empty statement) is structurally different, and the margin (1.0) is below the dev-selected threshold, so IntelliFix lists alternatives while ranking the intended repair first.
